question: What is the meaning of detailed information on the materials used in relation to material composition?
data_point: detailed information on the materials used
description: Detailed information on the materials used in relation to material composition is crucial for understanding the environmental impact, safety, and sustainability of building materials. It includes data on the percentage of raw materials, criticality, recycled content, origin, product name, ID, manufacturer details, location in the building, warranties, service life, condition assessment, temporal information, and updates. This comprehensive data supports urban mining practices, design for deconstruction, and encourages the use of secondary materials, ultimately promoting a circular economy and reducing dependence on raw material extraction.
